title: Quick quiz: how rebate programs work
intro: Seven questions that apply almost everywhere. Tap an answer to see why.
messages: Worth another read of the guide above.

Perfect score. You know your stuff.

qs.q: When should you check if you qualify for a rebate?
options: Only when the cheque is late
qs.why: Many programs refuse work that started before approval.

qs.q: Can you often combine rebates from different programs?
options: Often yes, but each program sets its own rules
qs.why: A utility rebate and a government one may stack. Check each program's stacking rules.

qs.q: Why do some rebates need a registered contractor?
options: The program pays only for work done by contractors on its list
qs.why: Check the official list before you accept a quote.

qs.q: What should you keep for your claim?
options: The invoice, model numbers and proof of payment
qs.why: Programs often ask for these, sometimes within a short window.

options: Programs and amounts often depend on who supplies your power or gas
It sets the price of the product
qs.why: Two homes in one city can have different rebates if they have different utilities.

qs.q: What is a qualified product list?
options: The models a program will pay a rebate on
A list of the cheapest products
qs.why: Check your exact model number before you buy.

qs.q: Can a program's amount or rules change?
options: Yes, programs open, change and close
qs.why: Always read the official page, and note the date you checked.
